purpose: Segment a window of narrated gameplay speech into complete incidents -- cause, climax and reaction -- so the editor can cut whole situations rather than the instants a signal detector spikes on (SPEC 19, 21, 26, 93). The model reads; correlation decides whether an incident is an event. Version 2 bounds every string and the list: unbounded, the model filled the output budget and the JSON was truncated, which cost a whole six-minute window of speech per failure and said so in one log line. Version 3 drops the quote field. Measured against the real model on a 77-minute Arabic transcript: three windows in fifteen died inside it, the model looping on repeated characters until the string never closed, and maxLength did not stop it because Ollama grammar-constrains shape rather than length. Removing the field took those three windows from truncated to parsed. The words themselves are not lost: the incident carries the span they were said in.

transcript.description: Timestamped lines, one per segment, as '[12.3] text'.
